known_gaps: The snapshot has no direct executable regression coverage for origin matching, local product-key ambiguity, or auth-provider policy denial.
The product access-entry branches for invited, pending, active, rejected, inactive, and open-mode reactivation are implemented but not directly covered by the available SQL regressions.
Product versus platform permission-key and permission-level fallback behavior, including last role-management actor protection, lacks current executable regression coverage in this snapshot.

The requirements catalog says auth-mode updates need product.auth_mode.update, but the current class-kit-admin-products implementation checks product level 75 with platform-level fallback; the wiki marks this catalog/runtime contradiction rather than treating the catalog as current behavior.
The permission-layer smoke checklist is historical design guidance and was not treated as proof of the current implementation.
